artworks.title: Balthus Turned to Stone
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains, a town, swirling clouds in the sky, a seated figure near a stream pointing towards a flying figure with wings and a caduceus, and a bull looking to the right. Lush trees and rocky formations frame the scene. The illustration uses fine line work resembling engravings with a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: Jupiter in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricately detailed landscape engraving. A figure is seated on a hill surrounded by foliage and paths. In the background, there are rolling hills under a dramatic sky with clouds. Another figure is positioned on the clouds. Large trees frame the composition. The overall color palette is monochrome with a play of light and shadow to create contrast and a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: A Man Showing Mercury the Eagle of Jupiter
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The etching shows a landscape with two figures near a body of water, a boat with a figure on the water, lush vegetation, trees, mountains, clouds, rolling hills, and buildings near the water. The etching is detailed and precise, using lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The monochromatic palette highlights the interplay of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Shepherd in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures on a tree branch, with one figure pointing into the distance. In a natural setting, the figures are perched on the branch. One of them is pointing towards the left side. The branch and surrounding foliage are detailed with fine lines. Movement is conveyed through the intricate lines in the leaves and figures' clothing. The drawing style is detailed with a narrative conveyed through the figures' gestures.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper body portrait of a person facing forward but slightly turned to their left. The person has delicate facial features, long wavy hair, and is wearing an elaborate coat over a high-collared garment. Their left hand is on their chest, and their right hand is on the back of a chair. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Pan Reclining before a Large Vase
artworks.medium: etching with tonal wiping on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the picture, revealing distant mountains and a body of water with detailed etching. To the left, two figures with rustic elements are depicted, one seated and leaning against a tree trunk with legs extended, while the other stands nearby with a staff. Further to the right, a large, ornate urn sits atop a raised stone structure. A sheep is depicted grazing close by. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette of black and white, emphasizing contrast. The artist’s signature, Castiglione, is engraved in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: The Washerwomen (Les laveuses)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on yellow wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains bold, curvilinear shapes and flowing lines creating an abstract configuration. A figure is seen bent over on the right, while on the left there is an abstract representation of a cow's head with horns and eyes. The background features swirling lines resembling clouds or water ripples. The composition blends organic and abstract elements harmoniously.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.9 x 20.7 cm (11 3/4 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a person riding a donkey carrying a child, led by another person, with sheep nearby under a palm tree adorned with celestial figures. The scene shows intricate details in the rendering of the tree, leaves, sheep, and figures, creating a sense of movement in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Still Life with Two Children Feeding Goats
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on faded blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on the right, holding onto a large goat. The color palette consists of brown, grey, and white. In the bottom left, there are vegetables like cabbages and pumpkins. To the right, there is a smaller figure. The background depicts a simple setting with sketchy outlines of a doorway and other objects.

artworks.title: Fortified Bridge against Distant Mountains
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a mountain rising from the water's edge. A fortification or tower is located on the mountain. The illustration shows fine etching lines detailing the mountain peaks, buildings, and water ripples. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia or brown tones. Three figures stand near the water, while a bridge extends over the water to a masonry structure. In the distance, a carriage drawn by horses moves towards the mountain. The sky has birds flying in it.

artworks.title: Justice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a seated figure, captured from head to toe. The person is in a sitting position, facing slightly to the right, with their body at a slight angle. Their facial features are softly rendered with delicate lines, and the hair appears to be long and loosely arranged. The clothing is depicted with flowing lines, suggesting robes or a gown with drapery. The figure holds a small round object in their right hand. The background is plain, with some stains and marks typical of an aged piece of paper.

artworks.title: A Great Oak Tree
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a ground-level perspective of a tall tree that takes up almost the entire paper. The horizon is low in the background, with an undulating, hilly landscape partially obscured by foliage. The tree's twisting branches and small leaves are intricately detailed with fine linework and textured shading. Detailed grass and small plants are visible near the base of the tree, and the sky behind it is clear. The background is blank, tan paper, and the lines of the drawing are gray.

artworks.title: Cupid Dancing with Two Allegorical Women
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in black and gray on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures and symbols. It depicts three central figures, including a winged child, holding hands with two draped female figures. The drawing features intricate detailing, movement in the flowing garments, decorative elements, and elaborate border design. Light and shadow through lines suggest depth and dimensionality in the figures and drapes.

artworks.title: The Fantastic Rocks and Castle at Bomarzo [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Morris and Gwendolyn Cafritz Foundation

artworks.title: The Fantastic Rocks and Castle at Bomarzo [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Morris and Gwendolyn Cafritz Foundation

artworks.title: The Convalescent (La convalescente)
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a seated woman from the waist up. She is turned slightly to the side, with her head tilted. She has distinct facial features with a calm expression and her hair is mostly hidden under a bonnet tied under her chin. She is wearing a cloak or loose-fitting garment that drapes around her shoulders. Her hand is gently resting in front of her. The background consists of sketched horizontal and vertical lines creating a textured look around her.

artworks.title: The Edge of a Wood at Nohant
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.description: This painting shows a dense forest scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is hidden by green trees and underbrush. Tall trees are visible in the center, sprouting above shorter bushes and ferns.  The undergrowth is dense with low shrubs and grasses, and we can see darker, shadowy sections that lead towards the depths of the forest. The color palette includes deep greens, browns, lighter greens, and ochres, with hints of blue-gray sky at the top beyond the green leaves.

artworks.title: Satyr Leaning on a Column
artworks.medium: black and white chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of the upper body of a person reclining or lying down, facing slightly upwards. The person's head is tilted back, with their eyes closed or looking upward. Their facial features, hair, and body contours are depicted with simple lines. The person appears to be nude, with one arm resting on a surface and the other arm of a different figure in an expressive gesture. The sketch is on textured paper with a plain background, drawn in pencil to emphasize outlines and shading.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion of Polycrates
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure on a cross. The drawing shows various figures surrounding a central figure on a cross, set on rocky terrain. The figures around it are engaged in different activities, with some gesturing upwards and others observing. The background features a detailed rocky and wooded landscape. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic style with intricate line work and textural detail.

artworks.title: Apostles Peter and John Healing the Paralytic
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30.8 x 42.6 cm (12 1/8 x 16 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a grand architectural setting. The architecture includes columns and arches. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, with some gesturing passionately while others observe. The clothing appears classical. The central focus is a group in the foreground interacting closely. The scene conveys a strong narrative element.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient Roman scene. The image depicts a figure sitting on a throne surrounded by other figures engaged in various activities. In the center, more figures are gathered in front of classical buildings and columns, with a statue atop a pedestal. To the right, figures surround a reclining person on a table, with a winged figure holding a laurel wreath above them. The drawing exhibits intricate line work and hatching typical of classical engravings.

artworks.title: Cavalryman Mounting a Horse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse and a person in motion. The drawing shows the horse with a flowing mane and a slightly restless posture, along with a tilted head and bent legs indicating movement or agitation. Beside the horse is a figure in a dynamic pose, possibly interacting with or controlling the horse based on their arm and leg positions. The medium is ink on paper, creating a fluid and sketch-like quality, with lines conveying movement and immediacy. The scene captures a moment of action in a minimalistic yet expressive style.

artworks.title: Sacrifice to Priapus
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 27.4 x 40.7 cm (10 13/16 x 16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in a classical scene. The image portrays numerous figures gathered around a central platform with a decorated pedestal or altar and flames. The figures are in various poses, some standing, others seated or reclining, with a sense of movement throughout the composition. Details such as helmets, draped garments, and classical architecture suggest a historical or mythological theme. Objects like shields and vessels can be seen, creating an atmosphere of ritual or ceremony. The drawing has a strong chiaroscuro effect and detailed line work, reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque art movements.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29 x 18 cm (11 7/16 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two adults and an infant in a classical style, standing together. The male figure on the left wears ornate armor and the female figure on the right embraces him, holding an infant. The male figure has short hair and strong features, wearing detailed armor and sandals. The female figure has her hair styled back and a relaxed expression, holding the infant who appears content. In the background, there is a cross-hatched design with varying shades, and the floor is patterned.
